crossRefs.note: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he…
He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and nursing babies…
Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep…
Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also…
From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half…

translations.web: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
translations.bsb: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
translations.kjv: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
translations.asv: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
